meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能调用本机 Ollama 上的模型：列出已装模型、让指定模型生成回答；开启管理开关后还能下载、删除模型、查看模型信息与运行状态。
howto.when: 当需要让容器代理接入本机 Ollama 时使用，通常由用户要求安装或配置 Ollama 集成而触发。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会列出模型，再选一个生成回答。

say.text: 列出已安装的 Ollama 模型
say.note: Claude 会调用列表工具显示模型。
需已开启管理工具，Claude 会下载该模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call local Ollama models: list installed models and have a specified model generate responses; if the admin flag is enabled, it can also pull/delete models and inspect model info/status.
howto.when_en: Used when integrating a local Ollama into the container agent, typically triggered by a user request to install or configure Ollama integration.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models, then generates an answer with one.
Claude calls the list tool to show them.
Requires admin tools; Claude downloads the model.
